title: Cleaning a CNF does not increase its width
statement: Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula over $n$ variables, and form its cleaned version by discarding every tautological clause (one containing two literals on the same variable with opposite signs) and then, within each surviving clause, keeping only the first occurrence of each variable. Writing the width of a CNF formula for the largest number of literals in any of its clauses (and $0$ for the empty formula), the width of the cleaned formula is at most the width of $\psi$.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary CNF formula over n variables (no side hypotheses)
replaced: The width of $\mathrm{cleanCNF\_D3}\,\psi$ is at most the width of $\psi$.
